name: Global Ensemble Forecast Parser Nodes
description: Pure WASM parser flow nodes for a machine-learned global ensemble weather forecast source (typed contracts 1.0): parse_cloud_chunks reads the hostcap/http-request HttpResponses (HRSP) of the Zarr v3 cloud-cover chunks - each carrying its own parse job in CONTEXT, the size-prefixed $WXF header record weathernext-source:plan built (field id, model, init/lead/valid time, member, variable, the tile's GRID and TILE_INDEX/TILE_COUNT, dtype, codec chain, origin, dataset, source URL, licence) - decodes each chunk through its declared codec chain (bytes float32/float16 in this build; a zstd stage reports codec-unsupported until a decoder is vendored), validates the byte length against the chunk extents, and emits one size-prefixed $WXF tile per chunk (VALUE_MIN/VALUE_MAX/MISSING_COUNT, licence class copied from the job) plus the batch's IngestRequest (INGQ: SOURCE TAGS, RECONCILE Duplicates, PROVENANCE; batch = sha256 of the concatenated chunk bodies). parse_cyclone_tracks turns the tropical-cyclone track CSV HttpResponse (CONTEXT: a $TCT header record) into one $TCT record per (storm, member) with points sorted by valid time, knots/hPa/nautical-mile source units converted exactly to m/s, Pa and km, wind radii at 34/50/64 kt by quadrant and the intensity category from maximum sustained wind; it emits the IngestRequest (with ARCHIVE naming), the record stream and the HttpResponse itself on raw, whose BODY storage-ingest archives. Node CONFIG (plugin.getConfig, the same flow-service config the source reads): weathernext_provider_id, and the padded chunk extents weathernext_chunk_lat/lon and dimension order weathernext_dims, which a $WXF header has no field for. Records are built with the spacedatastandards.org GENERATED C++ code. No capabilities: the only hostcall is the builtin plugin.getConfig. No JSON and no base64.

sequentialJustification.detail: Both methods are single-pass transforms over the frames the flow hands them: parse_cloud_chunks decodes each chunk body once into one tile record, parse_cyclone_tracks walks the CSV rows once and groups them by storm and member; the only hostcall is one synchronous plugin.getConfig. There is no shared mutable state, no worker pool and no fan-out inside the guest; the fan-out across chunks is the flow's, through the http connector node. This guest can never spawn a thread, so it compiles clang/wasi-sequential rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: Decodes N Zarr v3 chunk HttpResponses into N size-prefixed $WXF tile records plus one IngestRequest. Each response carries its own job in CONTEXT (the $WXF header record weathernext-source:plan built), so nothing pairs by position. A response that is not an HttpResponse is refused (invalid-response-frame), a CONTEXT that is not a $WXF header (invalid-chunk-job); a non-200 response fails the batch (fetch-failed); an undeclared codec fails it (codec-unsupported); a body whose length differs from chunk_lat * chunk_lon * itemsize fails it (chunk-size-mismatch). Padding beyond the declared global grid edge is dropped (the job's GRID names the tile's real rows and columns). The input port is multi-stream by contract (a fan-in from the http node), so no batched-frame guard applies.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (module-sdk runtime type HRSP) of one chunk GET: STATUS, BODY verbatim, CONTEXT = the chunk's size-prefixed $WXF header record.

inputPorts.description: One HttpResponse per chunk; every response handed to one invocation is one batch.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest's meta port.

outputPorts.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA WXF.fbs, TAGS (provider, source, batch = sha256 of the chunk bodies, source URL, content key, source peer, licence), RECONCILE Duplicates, PROVENANCE.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $WXF FlatBuffer record stream, one tile per chunk.

methods.description: Decodes the tropical-cyclone track CSV (one row per storm x member x lead) into one size-prefixed $TCT record per (storm, member) with points in ascending valid time, exact unit conversions (1 kt = 1852/3600 m/s, 1 hPa = 100 Pa, 1 nmi = 1.852 km), quadrant wind radii at 34/50/64 kt (blank -> -1 not reported, 0 stays 0), intensity category from maximum sustained wind and the genesis/existing origin flag, plus the IngestRequest (batch = sha256 of the CSV bytes) and the HttpResponse itself for archiving. BATCHING: the response port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind); a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames". See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (module-sdk runtime type HRSP) of the cyclone track CSV GET; CONTEXT = a size-prefixed $TCT header record.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse carrying the cyclone track CSV and its job.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest's meta port.

outputPorts.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA TCT.fbs, TAGS (batch = sha256 of the CSV bytes), RECONCILE Duplicates, ARCHIVE (weathernext / cyclone-tracks.csv), PROVENANCE.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $TCT FlatBuffer record stream, one track per (storm, member).
The input HttpResponse, verbatim (module-sdk runtime type HRSP).

outputPorts.description: The fetched document for archiving: storage-ingest's raw port archives its BODY under the IngestRequest's ARCHIVE naming.
